before.title: AIRMATIC Air Suspension Fault Warning
before.description: The EQE SUV with AIRMATIC air suspension generates intermittent fault warnings, causing the system to default to a fixed ride height. The issue is primarily a sensor calibration problem in the ride height sensors, which can be triggered by temperature swings or after driving through deep water.
before.solution: A dealer visit is required to recalibrate the ride height sensors using XENTRY. In most cases the sensors themselves are functional and only need recalibration. If faults persist, the ride height sensor at the affected corner should be replaced. Check for water intrusion in sensor connectors.
symptoms: Air suspension fault warning on dashboard
Vehicle stuck at one ride height
Unable to change ride height modes
Uneven ride height side to side

citations.title: MBWorld.org — EQE SUV AIRMATIC fault warning and sensor recalibration guide

communityRecommendations.content: Most AIRMATIC faults on the EQE SUV are sensor calibration issues, not actual hardware failures. A dealer recalibration usually resolves it. Save yourself the anxiety — it is rarely an expensive fix.

proposal.title: AIRMATIC Air Suspension Fault Warning
proposal.description: Mercedes XENTRY bulletin LI32.35-P-079752 (NHTSA communication 11023050) covers AMG-only model 294 vehicles with option 465 that display a shock symbol, “Do Not Drive Over 50MPH,” U013281 and C156F00. It identifies physical-layer wiring to the level-control sensors as the cause and prescribes freeze-frame, wiring and sensor inspection—not routine sensor recalibration. Communication 10231024 separately covers a 2022 EQE SUV AIRMATIC warning caused by moisture freezing in the compressor below zero. These narrower records do not establish the frozen temperature-swing/deep-water calibration problem across every 2023-2025 EQE SUV trim.
proposal.solution: Record the exact warning, DTCs, ride height, temperature and option codes. Obey a displayed speed restriction and obtain qualified suspension diagnosis. Use freeze-frame data to inspect the indicated wiring and level-sensor circuit before replacement; diagnose compressor, fuse and valve-block moisture only when the 10231024 symptom path applies. Do not buy a ride-height sensor, compressor, valve block, fuse or relay from this page; the failed path and universal retail part are not established.
symptoms: exact suspension warning and speed restriction recorded
wiring, sensor and compressor paths diagnosed separately

before.title: OTA Update Causing System Brick
before.description: Several EQE SUV owners report that OTA software updates have rendered vehicle systems non-functional, requiring a flatbed tow to a dealer for recovery. The bricked state prevents the car from entering ready mode, with the dashboard displaying only error messages.
before.solution: If the vehicle becomes unresponsive after an OTA update, do not attempt to force restart repeatedly. Contact Mercedes roadside assistance for a flatbed tow to a dealer. The dealer will reflash all control modules using XENTRY. Mercedes recommends initiating updates only when parked at home on Wi-Fi with a full charge.
symptoms: Vehicle will not enter ready-to-drive mode after update

citations.title: OTA Updates Frustration - Mercedes EQ Forum
Update issues car froze android auto problems - Mercedes EQ
Software update for combi instrument wont install - Mercedes EQ

communityRecommendations.content: Do not install OTA updates immediately after release. Wait 1-2 weeks and check forums for reports from early adopters. Always update on a full charge, parked at home with strong Wi-Fi.

proposal.title: OTA Update Causing System Brick
proposal.description: Mercedes XENTRY bulletin LI00.00-P-079603 (NHTSA communication 11023033) documents one SRS/ORC OTA update that may not start, with a grayed-out Continue button, on platforms including EQE SUV. It says the cause is under analysis, prescribes an SRS/ORC XENTRY update and explicitly limits the bulletin to the occupant-protection OTA. Other reviewed Mercedes OTA campaigns describe background installation without a workshop visit. No reviewed primary record establishes that an EQE SUV OTA update bricks the vehicle, prevents ready mode, requires a flatbed tow, or requires reflashing every control module across all 2023-2025 trims.
proposal.solution: Record the exact update name and code, control unit, software version, warnings, ready-mode status and Mercedes app status. If the vehicle will not enter ready mode, follow the operator safety guidance and contact Mercedes roadside assistance; do not infer the OTA caused the condition without diagnosis. For SRS/ORC update 25P5496529 that will not start, follow LI00.00-P-079603 through an authorized workshop. Do not buy or replace an MBUX head unit, communication module or restraint controller from this page; the failed path and universal retail part are not established.
symptoms: exact update name and code recorded
VIN campaign status checked before any hardware replacement
